build.title: Little Cabin
build.description: A cozy two-room cabin with a bright yellow floor and red walls. Perfect for a minifigure getaway!

steps.instruction: Lay the two yellow 2x4 plates side by side to form the cabin floor.
Place the two green 2x2 plates at each end of the floor as corner foundations.
Build the front and back walls by placing two red 2x4 bricks along the long edges of the floor.
Add the remaining two red 2x4 bricks on top of the first wall layer to raise the walls.
Place the two blue 2x2 bricks at the corners to reinforce the walls and add a pop of color.
Fill in the side walls with the four white 1x2 bricks, two per side, to close off the cabin.

tips: Offset each brick layer by one stud for a stronger, more realistic wall.
Try swapping the yellow plates for tan ones for a more natural wooden-floor look.
You can add a sloped piece on top as a roof if you have one handy.
alternateIdeas: A small swimming pool — lay the plates flat as the pool floor and stack the bricks around the edge.
A colorful park bench — use the 2x4 plates as seat and back, with 1x2 bricks as legs.
A tiny race car — use the 2x4 bricks as the body and the plates as a flat spoiler.
